# Gallery initial selection crashes while its Store is empty

## Context

The Gallery arm of `StoreLoadingNL.spec.mjs` failed in [PR #20406's hosted shard](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/42132796824/job/127614322043) while its HTTP request was deliberately held open. This is pre-existing: `Gallery.mjs` is byte-identical between that PR's base `8d70e70a27` and head `d37da9ecba`; the PR changes ComboBox ownership only.

## The Problem

`Gallery#afterSetMounted` waits 300 ms, reads dimensions, then chooses an initial record. For an empty Store, its index calculation yields zero and `getRecordId(store.getAt(0))` receives `undefined`:

```text
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'Symbol(Neo.internalId)')
Store.getInternalId → Gallery.getRecordId → Gallery.afterSetMounted callback
```

A controlled real Gallery/Store probe with an empty Store, the actual 300 ms timer and a resolved native-dimension reply reproduces the error with `count:0`, `selection:[]`. Existing loading unit coverage bypasses the hook through `view._mounted = true`, so it cannot catch this.

The same formula computes `index=count` for `amountRows:1`. The current falsey-key test also fails to distinguish an existing business key `0` from no selection.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: Gallery's existing `selectOnMount` config requests initial selection; `onStoreLoad` rebuilds items and preserves existing selection. Empty asynchronous data is already supported by the Store-loading contract delivered for #290.

Prescription checked: `src/component/Gallery.mjs#afterSetMounted` owns the delayed measurement and initial-selection request. `onStoreLoad` is where newly available records can fulfill that one-time request. `Store#getInternalId` is not the repair boundary.

## The Fix

Keep initial selection pending until the mounted Gallery has a valid visible record, then consume it once. Preserve the existing nonempty selection choice, clamp it to the visible record range, and distinguish key zero from absence. A completed initial request must not select again on later coarse loads or sorts.

Fence delayed measurement against unmount, destruction and render-window changes. Expected instance/window retirement settles quietly; unexpected native errors remain observable. Reuse the existing Store-load path and selection model.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Restored behavior | Fallback / docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `selectOnMount` with empty/late data | Existing Gallery config and loading support | No invalid record lookup; one initial selection when a visible record becomes available | False leaves unselected views unselected; method JSDoc | Controlled mount/late-load and native held-request cases |
| Existing selection and default index | GalleryModel and current mount formula | Valid existing key (including 0) survives; default index stays in range | No selection when no visible rows; no repeat on sort/load | Zero-key, one-row, normal multi-row and manual-deselect controls |
| Deferred native read | Existing instance-owned timeout / window departure contract | Stale completion cannot mutate an unmounted/destroyed/new-window view | Genuine failures still reported | Deferred-reply and cancellation controls |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An empty mounted Gallery can finish its dimension read with no thrown/unhandled error and no selection, while loading feedback remains correct.
- [ ] With `selectOnMount:true`, the pending initial request selects a valid rendered record once when data arrives; false and later manual deselection are respected across further loads/sorts.
- [ ] Normal populated default selection is preserved; `amountRows:1`, one visible record and an existing business key `0` never cause an invalid lookup or replacement.
- [ ] Unmount/destroy/window-change before deferred completion prevents stale writes or selection; expected cancellation is quiet and genuine native errors remain visible.
- [ ] Unit coverage exercises the actual mount hook (not a silent mounted assignment), and the held-request Gallery browser arm passes with the dimension-read boundary reached before data is released.

## Out of Scope

ComboBox repair #20403 / PR #20406, Calendar drag readiness, Helix redesign, global Store guards, and selecting anew on every load.

## Avoided Traps

Do not whitelist the error or weaken `workerErrors`. A bare null guard would prevent the exception but discard the initial-selection request for slow loads. A longer fixed sleep only moves the race.

## Related

#290 / PR #20343 (loading feedback), #16559 (selection preserved across rebuilds), PR #20406 (failure exposure). Self-owned immediate repair; no contributor reservation is displaced.
